# App icons · 应用图标

The LIM mark — a serif **L** (Less is More) on a brand color with a subtle top
sheen — rendered as the primary App Store icon plus 9 themed variants (the in-app
"更换 App 图标" skins). Generated by [`generate_icons.py`](generate_icons.py).

| File | Skin | BG |
|------|------|----|
| `icon_classic.png` / `AppIcon-1024.png` | 经典靛蓝 Classic (default) | `#34357C` |
| `icon_paper.png`   | 暖纸 Paper | `#E7E2D6` |
| `icon_ink.png`     | 墨黑 Ink | `#1B1B19` |
| `icon_sage.png`    | 山涧绿 Sage | `#5E7E63` |
| `icon_clay.png`    | 陶土 Clay | `#C0824F` |
| `icon_plum.png`    | 紫藤 Plum | `#9A6FB0` |
| `icon_sky.png`     | 晴空 Sky | `#5B86B0` |
| `icon_rose.png`    | 胭脂 Rose | `#C76B8E` |
| `icon_mono.png`    | 雾白 Mono | `#F4F3EE` |

`icons_preview.png` shows all nine with rounded corners.

## Specs

- **1024 × 1024**, opaque sRGB PNG, **no alpha, no rounded corners** — exactly
  what App Store Connect requires for the app icon. iOS applies the mask.
- The masters double as the source for every smaller size; modern Xcode generates
  the rest from a single 1024 in the asset catalog.

## How they're wired in the app

The primary icon and all 8 alternates live in the asset catalog
(`ios/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon*.appiconset`), and
`ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_INCLUDE_ALL_APPICON_ASSETS=YES` (set in `project.yml`)
bundles every `*.appiconset` as a selectable alternate. `AppIconView` calls
`UIApplication.setAlternateIconName("AppIcon-<Skin>")` (nil = classic) so the
home-screen icon actually changes, then persists the choice via the backend.

## Regenerate

```bash
pip install cairosvg pillow
python3 generate_icons.py     # writes icon_*.png, AppIcon-1024.png, icons_preview.png
```
